harness_signal: The API digest and .claude/rules do not cover rate limiting; the guren-api skill names rate-limit stores among the framework subsystems, and `createRateLimitMiddleware` / `RateLimitOptions` are exported from @guren/core with a login-route example in their JSDoc. Bare agents must either find that export or hand-roll a per-IP counter Map with a Date.now() window and a Retry-After header.
